source_and_cause_judgments.R754: Actual TYPE declarations distinguish bare non-PDT/defaulted PDT and positional/keyword/mixed forms. Empty parentheses are on an all-defaulted true PDT, avoiding C796 and missing-required C797 defects. The missing comma separates complete k=(5) and n=11 items, so digits/names cannot merge lexically.
source_and_cause_judgments.R755: Arrow, missing keyword and missing value each occur in a genuine type-parameter list and repair to the same n=3 source with other formals defaulted. Procedure arguments, pointer association, constructor components and intrinsic selectors are not substituted for this role.
source_and_cause_judgments.C795: scalar_name is an explicitly declared INTEGER object with a nonintrinsic identifier; TYPE(record) alone repairs the selector. In the privacy pair, the provider compiles first and the client USE has no ONLY/private-import defect. Provider-only PRIVATE-to-PUBLIC repairs the byte-identical client TYPE(hidden) use.
source_and_cause_judgments.C796: A true non-PDT receives one positional3, without an unknown keyword. Removing the list repairs only nonparameterization. Its control is not used to clear the separately pending canonical bare-name reuse facet.
source_and_cause_judgments.C797: Required k/n and defaulted pad isolate missing KIND/LEN without positional shifting. Three-item duplicate cases do not exceed three formals and use only real keywords with valid positional-prefix order. They repeat n or the positional k correspondence. Shared repairs supply k7/n3/pad5 once.
source_and_cause_judgments.C798: Three/four defaulted abstract KIND formals and a later c/d keyword avoid obvious missing or duplicate correspondence. The repair names an unused earlier formal. No mapping is assigned to invalid order; valid repairs map a11/b2/c31 and a11/b22/c3/d44.
source_and_cause_judgments.C799: Every genuine formal is defaulted. nn is unknown and payload is a real ordinary component, not a formal parameter. Replacing only that keyword with n repairs the TYPE list, without a constructor or missing-value context.
source_and_cause_judgments.C7100: The sole negative is an ordinary nondummy/nonassociate local LEN*, repaired to3 with KIND7 fixed. SELECT TYPE uses a nonoptional polymorphic dummy and an extensible same-type/kind guard with all lengths assumed. The allocation control uses an allocatable fixed-n5 actual and assumed-n dummy with identical empty deferred sets; C939 requires n=* for the one dummy object. Conditional allocation/STAT handling and defined payload keep its complete body valid, with no absent-LEN inquiry. All are compile admissions, not runtime effects.
